system.name: DDSR
system.one_liner: Sequential recommender that models interaction sequences as fuzzy sets through discrete state-space diffusion and replaces item IDs with semantic IDs from item descriptions.

content.variant_note: three dashed panels: nested rings of items around a final choice, two tilted planes (history above, fuzzy sets below) joined by dotted arrows, and a description-to-semantic-ID table
content.argues: A user's choice reflects blurred, unpredictable interests; fuzzy sets from discrete diffusion over the history plus semantic IDs from item text model this better.
content.subject: Nested state-space rings, a history plane diffused into a plane of fuzzy sets, and a table from item descriptions to semantic IDs.

elements.name: Discrete state space
elements.role: space of items; interest is focused on some items with blurred boundaries and converges when the user chooses
elements.drawn_as: grey pill label under three nested pale-green discs with blue dots and one orange dot at the centre

elements.name: orange dot
elements.role: the item finally chosen, at the centre of the rings (read from the drawing)
elements.drawn_as: orange circle at the centre of the discs

elements.name: User Historical Interactions
elements.role: observed sequence of items, each a node with grey transition arrows between them
elements.drawn_as: tilted peach plane with six grey item icons, blue ellipses and arrows

elements.name: Transitions between items
elements.role: legend entry for the directed edges between consecutive items
elements.drawn_as: grey arrow in a rounded legend pill

elements.name: Item
elements.drawn_as: blue dot in a rounded legend pill

elements.name: Discrect Diffusion
elements.role: discrete diffusion that turns each history item into a fuzzy set
elements.drawn_as: label beside five dotted blue arrows running from the upper plane to the lower plane

elements.name: fuzzy sets
elements.role: the generated sets of items, one per history item, linked by the same transitions
elements.drawn_as: six pale-green ellipses on a tilted blue plane joined by grey arrows; a green zoom box with blue dots tied by a thin dark line to one ellipse

elements.name: Item to be recommended
elements.role: the next item the model must predict, reached from the last fuzzy set
elements.drawn_as: dark-blue dot at the end of a grey line with a large label

elements.name: Descriptions
elements.role: item descriptions, e.g. 'Roses regency teacup and saucer.'
elements.drawn_as: column of light-blue rounded text cards with an ellipsis between rows

elements.name: Semantic IDs
elements.role: tuples of three codes that replace item IDs, e.g. (12, 31, 98)
elements.drawn_as: column of tuples on a light-grey strip, each after a grey arrow from its description

elements.name: Seq2seq model
elements.role: generates the semantic ID of an item from its description
elements.drawn_as: text label above a thick pale-blue down arrow to a photo and the tuple (17, 42, 51)

new_tags.name: stacked-tilted-planes

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a method on a toy scene: draw the observed items on one tilted plane and the derived sets on a second plane below, join them with dotted arrows labelled with the operation, keep the transitions as grey arrows on both planes, and add a corner legend.
lessons.suits: Methods that turn a sequence or set of observed items into a derived representation (sets, clusters, latent states), where a spatial metaphor helps.

evidence: a user’s interest at any given moment might be focused on ’some items’ with blurred boundaries
a vivid illustration of this is given on the right side of Figure 1.

summary: DDSR is a sequential recommender that treats a user's interaction sequence as fuzzy sets produced by discrete diffusion, and uses semantic IDs built from item descriptions. Figure 1 has three dashed panels. On the left, nested pale-green discs with blue item dots around an orange centre show interest with blurred boundaries that converges on a choice. In the middle, a peach plane of historical items joined by grey transition arrows sends dotted blue arrows through Discrete Diffusion to a blue plane of green fuzzy sets and the item to be recommended, with a zoom box and a legend. On the right, item descriptions map to three-number semantic IDs via a seq2seq model.
summary_zh: DDSR把用户交互序列建模为离散扩散得到的模糊集，并用语义ID代替物品ID。图1分三块虚线框：左为模糊边界的离散状态空间，中为历史物品平面扩散成模糊集平面并指向待推荐物品，右为描述到语义ID。
notes: The meaning of the orange dot, of the ring tones and of the dessert photo with (17, 42, 51) is read from the drawing and the caption, not stated in the text; hence medium. The two tilted planes are bitmaps used as backgrounds, listed in pictures with role background. The top fifth of the canvas is blank.
